def transform(grid):

    row_line = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)

        lo, hi = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
        shift = row_line + 1 - lo if lo > row_line else row_line - 1 - hi
        for r, c in pts:
            out[r][c] = bg
        for r, c in pts:
            out[r + shift][c] = grid[r][c]
        side = hi + shift + 1 if lo > row_line else lo + shift - 1
        if 0 <= side < h:
            out[side] = [8] * w
        return out
    if col_line is not None:
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]

        for r, c in pts:
            out[r][c] = bg
        for r, c in pts:

        side = hi + shift + 1 if lo > col_line else lo + shift - 1
